title: Concept: Module substituted by an unreleased pseudo-version
description: go.mod declares a `replace` directive that pins a pre-release pseudo-version, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a `replace` directive that pins a pre-release pseudo-version.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through go.mod (go).
risk: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a `replace` directive that pins a pre-release pseudo-version.
